map_function_nest: apply a function recursively to all leaf values in a nested tuple, list, or dict structure
flatten_function_nest: flatten a nested tuple, list, or dict into a flat sequence of leaf values
zip_function_nests: zip multiple nested structures together element-wise preserving the shape of the first nest
map_many_function_nests: apply a function to corresponding leaf values across multiple nested structures simultaneously
review_nest_module: review the nest module functions for recursive mapping, flattening, zipping, and multi-nest operations
